title: Reforge slot UI (Goblin Tinkerer)
player_outcome: 'Reforge' opens your inventory with a 'Place an item here to reforge' slot, the cost in coin colours and a hammer button. Each click clangs, charges you, and the tooltip instantly shows the new prefix.
design:
Core TownServices:
- `ReforgeCost(npc, player, ItemStack stack)` and `Reforge(npc, player, Inventory inv, int slot, out ItemStack result)`.
- The existing held-item overloads (TownServices.cs:35-58) delegate, so commands and tests are unchanged.
- Pays from the purse (P2-06). Raises a `Reforged` event.

New game/UI/Inventory/ServicePanel.cs (reforge mode) in the panel host.
- A caption, and one ItemSlotView bound to PlayerInventory.Service[0] that accepts Prefixes.CanHave items.
- A 'Cost: …' line in coin colours, hidden when the slot is empty.
- A reforge_hammer TextureButton that calls Reforge.
- Hammer feedback: a new 'reforge' SFX recipe (metallic clang) and a slot Scale 1.1 → 1 tween. The TooltipFollower re-reads the slot.
`InventoryScreen.OpenService(npc, ServiceMode.Reforge)`, called from the TownDialog Reforge button. Closing the inventory or dialog stows Service[0] to the backpack, dropping it at the feet if full.
Structure ServicePanel so the NPC phase's Guide 'Help' slot (recipes using an item) can add a mode reusing the P2-18 recipe views.
files_modify: game/UI/InventoryScreen.cs — OpenService, stow the Service slot on close
tests: TownServicesTests: ReforgeWorksOnTheServiceSlot; CostIsZeroForUnprefixableItems; ServiceSlotStowedOnClose (via PlayerInventory helper)

ui.cmds: `town summon goblin_tinkerer 0 0 -3` / `ui talk goblin_tinkerer` / `give copper_broadsword 1` / `give gold_coin 5` / `ui reforge` (opens the panel) / `invclick backpack <slot> left` / `invclick service 0 left` / `ui reforge hit` / `assert errors == 0` / `ui close`
verification: Headless smoke; lavapipe screenshot of the reforge panel
risks: P3 replaces the prefix table (Terraria prefixes). The UI reads prefixes generically.
